id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.ic_name: System Management Bus (SMBus 3.1) + Power Management Bus (PMBus 1.3)
fields.topology_type: Multi-drop 2-wire bus derived from I2C: all devices share SMBCLK and SMBDAT via open-drain wired-AND, with an optional shared SMBALERT# (wired-OR). At most one host manages the bus; PMBus power devices add a CONTROL pin.

supported_topologies.name: Single-host multi-device
supported_topologies.description: One host plus multiple SMBus/PMBus slaves on the shared 2-wire bus.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-master
supported_topologies.description: Multiple masters arbitrate for the bus (wired-AND arbitration, lowest address/data wins).

supported_topologies.name: PMBus multi-rail / multi-device
supported_topologies.description: PAGE selects rails within a device; group and Zone Read/Write commands coordinate many devices.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Special master that manages the bus, handles SMBALERT#/Host Notify, and runs ARP (at most one).
Responds to its 7-bit address; a PMBus power device is a slave with a CONTROL pin.

fields.interconnect_role: SMBus is a shared control/management bus; PMBus is the power-management application protocol on top. Devices are addressed by 7-bit address (optionally ARP-assigned); the host configures, controls, and monitors them, and is interrupted via SMBALERT#.

ordering_guarantees.single_transaction: One transaction at a time on the shared bus.
ordering_guarantees.group_zone: Group / Zone commands defer the action to a common STOP so multiple devices act together.
ordering_guarantees.alert_arbitration: Lowest address wins the Alert Response; lowest UDID wins ARP enumeration.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: SMBus/PMBus is command/protocol-oriented, not memory-mapped. PMBus exposes a command-code space (0x00..0xFF) paged by PAGE; there is no linear memory address space on the bus.

ic_name: System Management Bus (SMBus 3.1) + Power Management Bus (PMBus 1.3)
